oldText:
- Bad: guard says "all good here" → "Great work, keep it up! 👍" (empty praise; on a
  patrol post it rubber-stamps rounds you never checked).
  Good: location shows no movement for 40 min on a 30-min patrol → "Thanks, when you
  get a sec, can you walk the north lot? Haven't seen movement over there in a bit."
newText:
- Bad: guard says "all good here" → "Great work, keep it up! 👍" (empty praise; on a
  patrol post it rubber-stamps rounds you never checked).
  Good: location shows no movement for 40 min on a 30-min patrol → "Thanks, I have your
  all-clear. Location looks incomplete on my end. Was your phone with you and online
  for the loop?" Ask for the missing evidence; do not direct a repeat patrol or
  escalate from the telemetry mismatch alone.
intendedEffect: Make the first response to telemetry-only ambiguity an evidence-seeking clarification, preventing repeat-work directives and escalation until there is additional evidence or an independent post risk.
